{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out the invalid age value (-1)
valid_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the number of valid customers and the mean age
num_valid_customers = len(valid_customers)
print(f'Number of valid customers: {num_valid_customers}')
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age}')"}
